title: Gas Station
description: There are circular gas stations. `gas[i]` is the fuel available at station `i`; `cost[i]` is the fuel needed to travel from station `i` to the next. Return any starting station index that allows a full circuit, or -1 if no such start exists.
hints: Sort or scan while maintaining the best feasible choice.
Check tie values and cases where no feasible choice remains.
